newsitem.title: MEXICO: FEMSA syndicated loan set for May.
newsitem.headline: FEMSA syndicated loan set for May.

text.p: Mexican brewer and bottler Fomento Economico Mexicano S.A. (FEMSA) said on Tuesday it would finalize a three-year $350 million syndicated loan in early May.
The money is needed to replace a $300 million Eurobond that comes due on July 22.
"We expect to finish the transaction at the start of May," Jose Antonio Fernandez, director general of FEMSA, told a news conference at a stockholders meeting.
Swiss Bank Corp will be the lead manager on the deal with ING Barings and JP Morgan as co-leaders, Fernandez said.
"The interest rate for this credit will start at 1.625 over Libor (London Interbank Offered Rate) a will increase in later years," Fernandez said.
